summary: Verified FIX 1-5 for grade/section dropdowns and unified input-field styling across teacher & student pages. All primary fixes work correctly. One inconsistency found: gen-grade-select in QuestionBank AI-generate dialog still uses old white-theme classes (visually dark only due to global CSS override), contradicting FIX 3 intent.

ui_bugs.issue: gen-grade-select does NOT use 'input-field' class as claimed by FIX 3. It still has the old white-theme classes: 'w-full border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-violet-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-100'. Its label also uses text-slate-700. Renders dark visually ONLY because a global CSS override coincidentally styles selects — but inconsistent with sibling gen-topic-select (which uses input-field). File: /app/frontend/src/components/teacher/QuestionBank.jsx lines 332-344.

issues: Pre-existing React DOM nesting warnings pollute console: '<span> cannot appear as a child of <option>/<select>/<th>/<tr>/<tbody>/<td>' — appears to come from a devtools instrumentation wrapper (x-component) but produces noisy React warnings. Non-blocking but should be investigated.

action_items: OPTIONAL LOW-PRIORITY: In /app/frontend/src/components/teacher/QuestionBank.jsx (lines 332-344), replace the manual class on gen-grade-select with className='input-field' and change label className from 'text-slate-700' to match the dark theme (e.g. use theme text color) for full consistency with FIX 3 intent. Currently visually OK due to global CSS override, but not aligned with the pattern used elsewhere.

OPTIONAL: Investigate source of x-component/x-line-number wrappers producing invalid DOM nesting warnings (span inside option/select/table cells) — likely a devtools instrumentation that should be disabled in production build.
critical_code_review_comments: GRADES map at /app/frontend/src/utils.js is the single source of truth and works correctly across all consumers (Gradebooks create modal, StudentGrades). Fallback in sectionsOfGrade returns [1..7] for undefined grades (التاسع/العاشر) — verified.
In Gradebooks.jsx line 267 the onChange correctly resets section to empty when grade changes — verified in browser.
Backend gradebook create endpoint validated creation with السادس/section=7 (200 response, navigation to detail page succeeded).
seed_data_creation: Created one test gradebook (السادس / section 7 / 2 students) during end-to-end test — cleaned up successfully via DELETE /api/gradebooks/{id}. No leftover test data. No rubric was created (create-rubric modal not exercised, existing rubric 'اساسيات الحاسوب' used).
context_for_next_testing_agent: FIX 1 (section counts), FIX 2 (gradebook create modal), FIX 3 (QuestionBank filters), FIX 4 (RubricPrint gb select), FIX 5 (.env) all verified. Student-side /my-grades uses input-field selects correctly and has correct grade list (no التاسع/العاشر). Only remaining minor inconsistency is gen-grade-select in QuestionBank AI-generate dialog missing input-field class. Test data cleanup done via API DELETE.
